facts: G-CASCADE-01: one French-national adult aged35, habitually residing in metropolitan France; no spouse, children or other household members. All statutory housing-benefit eligibility conditions are adjudicated satisfied.

Zone II, standard unfurnished conventioned rental, not colocation, not foyer, not accession; monthly eligible rent400.00 EUR. No special abatement, student status, disability or nonstandard housing adjustment.

Housing-benefit annual resource assessment is expressly given as4800.00 EUR for this calculation; current professional earnings400.00 EUR/month. No other assessed resource, no special deduction or abatement. Do not infer an assessed annual amount from a single recent quarter.

Month of rightJune2026; serving fund identified; no debt withholding, fraud, recovery, remission or shared recipient arrangement. Housing allowance actually RECEIVED200.00 EUR in February, March and April2026, and June2026. Actual received amounts are separate factual receipts, not a supplied expected June entitlement.

RSA/PA common reference months February/March/April2026 each have actual professional earnings400.00 EUR and actual housing allowance received200.00 EUR; the hypothetical RSA/PA bases600 are irrelevant to computing housing benefit.

No reduction de loyer de solidarite (RLS) applies; RLS amount0.00 EUR. Neither AAH nor AEEH is received, and no other current benefit or in-kind income exists beyond the stated professional earnings and housing allowance.
